name: Montclair Place
summary: Familiar department stores & other retailers line this modern 2-story mall with a food court.
description: Montclair Place is a premier shopping destination in the Inland Empire featuring a diverse mix of popular retailers, dining options, and entertainment including movies. With convenient hours and a VIP rewards program, shoppers can enjoy exclusive deals, follow their favorite stores, and stay informed about sales and special events throughout the year.
demographics: Montclair Place serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in the Inland Empire region of Southern California, drawing primarily from families and young adults aged 25-54 with moderate household incomes. The trade area encompasses the eastern San Bernardino and western Riverside counties, attracting value-conscious shoppers seeking mainstream brands and affordable dining options. Typical visitors include multi-generational Hispanic and multicultural families who prefer one-stop shopping experiences with a mix of fashion, entertainment, and family-friendly amenities.
